data.one_liner: Typed Dart and Flutter SDK for Vendure GraphQL APIs
data.what_it_does: Provides a channel-aware client for Vendure commerce APIs, supporting catalog, cart, checkout, payment, and customer domains via GraphQL. Includes both a real HTTP/WebSocket data source and an in-memory implementation for testing.
use_when: You are building an app or service that communicates with a Vendure e-commerce backend
You need channel-aware catalog, cart, and order management in Dart
You want a structured repository pattern with testable in-memory data sources
avoid_when: You prefer writing raw GraphQL queries and mutations manually without a typed SDK
strengths: Complete coverage of Vendure shop and admin domains
Built-in support for multiple auth strategies including native, Firebase, custom, and API keys
Includes an in-memory data source for offline development and testing
weaknesses: Tied strictly to the Vendure e-commerce ecosystem
data.setup_notes: Requires running build_runner to generate zorphy and json entities.

alternatives.name: dio
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer a flexible HTTP client for custom REST APIs instead of a dedicated Vendure GraphQL SDK.

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want a lightweight standard HTTP client for manual API calls.
